message: PO-WIRE-DELTA-005 expected_evidence hard-codes a stale tally invariant: 'cargo test -p vb_storage --lib' was required to exit 0 with summary line 'test result: ok. 950 passed; 0 failed; 0 ignored; 0 measured; 0 filtered out' (and the underlying claim cited a pre-wire baseline of 924 sourced from .beads/vb-2bok/qa-report.md:5 and .beads/vb-core-atomic-admission/STATE.md:1349). Direct execution of `PROPTEST_CASES=1 cargo test -p vb_storage --lib` from /home/lewis/src/isoloated/velvet-ballistics-cheap25-vb-n5k6v at 2026-07-01 reports `test result: ok. 1530 passed; 0 failed; 0 ignored; 0 measured; 0 filtered out; finished in 1.00s`. The cited sources were correct for the historical May 2026 baseline, but vb_storage has accumulated additional #[test] fns since that capture. The post-wire tally must be 1530 + 26 = 1556, not 950. The +26 delta invariant was correct (the wire surfaces exactly 26 dormant tests), but the absolute number '950' was wrong.
required_fix: Update the expected_evidence field of PO-WIRE-DELTA-005 (and the underlying CC-WIRE-005 contract clause, proof-strategy.md §6, proof-coverage-matrix.md §1/§8, trusted-base-plan.md §1/§5/§6/§12/§13/§15) to use the current actual baseline of 1530 (verified by `PROPTEST_CASES=1 cargo test -p vb_storage --lib 2>&1 | tail -3` from the isolated workdir at 2026-07-01) and post-wire expected of 1556 (1530 + 26). The +26 delta invariant and the anti-invariant language ('regression = below 1530', 'partial wire = delta below +26', 'test-budget leak = delta above +26') remain unchanged.
